thread:
sanjay: quick heads-up, seeing a ~9% drop in prefix-cache hitrate for model openlm-7B after the quant packer rollout. started around 11:00 UTC. not sure if it's more evictions or fragmentation.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: quant-packer/v2 -> prod @ 11:00 UTC (PR #10102) :white_check_mark:

maria: grafana snapshot: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/kv-pref?from=now-3h&to=now — node-3 and node-7 diverge in hotset hitrate.

devin: can you grab the node counters (hits/misses/evicts) and slot stats? did the packer change block alignment or remove padding? PR mentioned tighter packing.

sanjay: pasted node-7 counters at 11:05 UTC:
```
KV_NODE node=7 prefix_hits=210345 prefix_misses=25678 evictions=9210 free_slots=2830 slot_frag_ratio=0.52
KV_LAYOUT slots=131072 avg_free_run=3 max_free_run=48
```

lina: i'll spin the kv_profiler on a canary node and collect fragmentation map + heap pprof. where should i upload?

devin: use s3://redwood-kv-profiles/1997689012/ and run against canary first. flags: --sample=1s --dur=300 --capture=fragmap,heap. keep it non-disruptive.

lina: started profiler on node-3 (canary) at 11:22 UTC with `./kv_profiler --node=node-3 --sample=1s --duration=300 --out=1997689012-node3.tar.gz`. will upload when done.

sanjay: note: suspect change is removal of 1-3 byte padding when switching to 4-bit pack format — could create many small freed runs. PR comment: "drop trailing pad to reduce mem overhead".

maria: infra, any auto-scrub or compaction activity around 11:05-11:10? grafana shows compaction spike on node-7 at 11:07. tagging @luke.

luke: confirmed: auto-scrub compaction kicked on node-7 at 11:07 (policy: frag>0.45). no OOMs, but compaction IOPS spiked ~3x for ~90s.

lina: uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-kv-profiles/1997689012/node3.tar.gz and node7.tar.gz. profiler extract shows avg_free_run in hot prefixes dropped 6->2.5 and slot_frag_ratio in those ranges jumped 0.27->0.54. attaching flamegraph to the PR.

devin: that strongly points to internal fragmentation from tighter packing. plan: 1) reproduce locally with old pad vs new packer, 2) microbench allocation size distribution, 3) try a canary rollback to validate.

sanjay: i pushed a rollback canary build (PR #10108) that restores 1-byte padding for hot allocations. canary started @ 11:55 UTC.

maria: can we add a CI smoke that checks median free_run for hotset >= 4 for the model? would catch this class of regressions.
devin: agree. i'll draft a test and add it behind a flag in infra-tests so it doesn't slow down all runs.
lina: added profiler flamegraph and a short note about fragmentation hotspots to PR #10102. running local microbench now, will post numbers (alloc distribution + eviction delta).

sanjay: if the rollback on canary improves hitrate, we should consider a hotfix preserving space savings for cold prefixes but keeping pad for hot ones. maybe conditional alignment by size-class.
devin: yep, design options: selective padding, adjust slot binning, or change compaction threshold. i'll sketch options.
maria: ok — reconvene here once the canary numbers land. thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:
